scope: Bounded inventory of designated manuscript-supporting studies, not exhaustive historical census; source files are existing aggregate results only.
counting_rules: Reference datasets recur across studies; do not sum per-study cases into independent datasets.
Initial Agent contexts, dependent review branches, prescribed statistical laws, sampling seeds, tables, model calls and fictional rows are different units.
Three random seeds are within-law repetition, never three independent constructors.
A completed artifact may fail execution; a revised program may produce unchanged data.
API costs are captured-usage tariff estimates, not invoices or whole-project labor cost. Unknown historical costs remain null.
Two-round synthesis and scientific-use review reuse results and are not new experimental replication.

study_inventory.label: Evidence-information main study
study_inventory.design: 2 cases ×2 information conditions ×5 fresh Agent constructions; one prescribed statistical law per case-condition.

accounting.reason: Historical host/subagent construction: complete API identity/usage billing not captured. Unknown is not zero.

findings: Adding supplied relationship evidence decreased mean absolute sample-reference discrepancy in 5 of6 prespecified analyses; CHNS BMI association worsened.
20 Agent laws all delivered; numeric relation use was verified, but no source-population replay or scientific revision occurred.
interpretation_limits: The 5/6 count is a descriptive information contrast, not a dataset success rate or isolated Agent-method superiority.
Both reference families were already exposed; no new independent clinical validation.
Statistical comparators were closer on some analyses; do not claim general Agent superiority.

study_inventory.label: Open literature-to-cohort replication
study_inventory.design: 4 fresh Agent laws across2 glycemia cases, starting from research requests and finding their own evidence.

accounting.reason: Historical host/subagent construction: complete API identity/usage billing not captured. Unknown is not zero.

findings: All4 laws delivered12 final tables and kept their initial scientific structures.
ENSANUT E01/E02 retain positive conditional associations and BMI coefficient attenuation after glucose adjustment in all6 tables; age magnitude and HbA1c dispersion still differ.
interpretation_limits: Same exposed references as main study; additional source retrieval does not create a new clinical validation family.
Runnable analyses and directional patterns do not establish valid effect sizes, prediction, mediation or calibrated inference.

study_inventory.label: Fixed-packet cross-model API pilot
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: 5 model configurations from4 providers ×2 tasks ×2 initial construction attempts; fixed sources, no retrieval or feedback.

accounting.basis: captured provider usage and frozen published tariffs; not invoice; DeepSeek peak estimate

findings: 14/20 initial attempts delivered laws; all42 available final tables executed. Six incomplete/truncated responses remain failures of delivery.
All delivered primary directions match sample-reference point directions; dependence and dispersion discrepancies remain.
interpretation_limits: Incomplete models have no measured scientific quality; do not rank them as quality zeros.
Aliases and receipt usage are recorded, not immutable provider weight snapshots.
Fixed evidence packets differ from end-to-end autonomous retrieval.

study_inventory.label: Economy configuration and dependent feedback pilot
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: 8 new initial attempts plus4 dependent reviews of2 prespecified parents; same fixed evidence packets.
findings: 6 initial laws delivered,4 review branches delivered;30 final files but21 distinct hashes.
Three reviews retain their parent. One age-tail revision changes age support; it does not improve core lipid analysis.
interpretation_limits: Four reviews are dependent branches, not4 new independent initial constructors.
3 code-execution failures and3 unavailable final slots remain; unknown cost reserve is not measured spend.
One intended counterbalancing order was not achieved; do not interpret as a clean feedback-effect experiment.

study_inventory.label: Request-only initial pilot
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: Ordinary Agent vs workflow, starting from the same research needs with shared retrieval/generation tools;4 fresh sessions per round.
findings: 2/4 sessions finalized; 6/12 final slots produced tables, with all missing slots retained.
interpretation_limits: Fresh authors, sources and shared interfaces/budgets differ across rounds; delivery progression is not an isolated causal effect of engineering changes.
Previously exposed reference families; no new clinical confirmation.

study_inventory.label: Request-only interface repair
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: Ordinary Agent vs workflow, starting from the same research needs with shared retrieval/generation tools;4 fresh sessions per round.
findings: 2/4 sessions finalized; 6/12 final slots produced tables, with all missing slots retained.
interpretation_limits: Fresh authors, sources and shared interfaces/budgets differ across rounds; delivery progression is not an isolated causal effect of engineering changes.
Previously exposed reference families; no new clinical confirmation.

study_inventory.label: Request-only capacity diagnostic
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: Ordinary Agent vs workflow, starting from the same research needs with shared retrieval/generation tools;4 fresh sessions per round.
findings: 4/4 sessions finalized; 12/12 final slots produced usable tables.
Capacity diagnostic delivered all4 laws; earlier incomplete slots were not retrospectively repaired or selected.
interpretation_limits: Fresh authors, sources and shared interfaces/budgets differ across rounds; delivery progression is not an isolated causal effect of engineering changes.
Previously exposed reference families; no new clinical confirmation.

study_inventory.label: Frozen autonomous repeatability batch
reference_contexts: Brazilian adult blood pressure / PNS reference
study_inventory.design: 2 task contexts ×2 policies ×3 fresh author contexts using gpt-6.1-sol high reasoning.
findings: All12 fresh sessions generated final data from requests, autonomous search and Agent-authored laws.
Both policies show analysis-specific strengths and discrepancies; no general workflow superiority.
All6 lipid-author HDL means are negative, but only16/18 seed slopes are negative: W2 is sign-unstable.
One retained lipid table contains one HDL>TC row; no BP table violates evaluated SBP>=DBP.
interpretation_limits: PNS_BASE_R3 samples shared model parameters per seed; its seed range includes scenario variation. Other11 laws use fixed scientific parameters.
Seed ranges are not constructor replication or calibrated source/model/transport intervals.
A PNS-family title/abstract preview exposure is recorded; these are developmental, not perfectly screened independent clinical confirmation.

study_inventory.label: Mathematical, physiological and joint-analysis review
study_inventory.design: 12 existing laws ×2 dependent review policies; both have the same tools; structured policy additionally requires declaration coverage.
findings: R04 both policies repair a genuine ideal-law moment defect. Their final analysis discrepancies remain mixed; repair is not general statistical-quality improvement.
R07 both policies modify rounding/acceptance logic, but all6 final outputs equal their original tables.
66/72 outputs unchanged:60 explicit retentions plus6 R07 outputs. Only6 R04 outputs differ.
interpretation_limits: 24 reviews are not new independent constructors; retained outputs remain part of the evidence.
A completed checker receipt validates declared consistency/coverage, not source extraction, population transport or biomedical validity.
The same single HDL>TC record remains reproduced in both retained R08 branches; do not double-count independent failures.

study_inventory.label: Scientific-use interpretation and biomedical review packet
study_inventory.design: Aggregate-only interpretation of2 deliberately complementary cases; no new experiment.

accounting.basis: This read-only review unit only; source experiments retain their own historical costs.

findings: ENSANUT demonstrates selected positive associations and adjusted-BMI attenuation, with age/dispersion limitations.
Lipids demonstrate runnable joint analysis but under-recovered dependence and weak/unstable HDL associations in some laws.
Four-page reviewer brief plus blank analysis-use form is prepared; no human biological verdict has been received.
interpretation_limits: These2 cases were deliberately selected for complementary interpretation; not a project-wide success-rate census.
Mean/seed consistency, causal use, patient-specific recovery and inference from synthetic sample size remain distinct claims.
